policy: Use the supported direct weapon-firing elements of the selected current item definition, including alternate firing modes, inherent multi-element projectiles and fixed catalyst element conversion.
For a current item with variable-element drops, include its supported roll elements; never combine historical reissue elements.

Exclude elemental subclass buffs, optional random-roll conversion perks, incidental kill-triggered secondary explosions, reflected enemy attacks and ordinary Glaive melee. Fixed Exotic catalyst conversion such as Traveler's Chosen Osmosis is included.
Tessellation and Ergo Sum have Kinetic placeholder data in the generic Manifest preview; replace it with supported firing elements.
